description:
Notice of Intent         

Medical Readiness Contracting Office-West intends to award a sole source contract with Olympus America, Inc. for the Upgrade and Full Service Maintenance on VaultStream EasyViewer.  Applicable NAICS code 541512, size standard is $34,000,000. 

This notice is not a request for competitive quotes. No requests for capability briefings will be honored as a result of this notice and any information provided will not be used as part of any subsequent solicitation requirement. No telephonic inquires will be honored. A determination by the Government not to compete with this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government.

THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. This is a notice of intent to award a sole source contract for the Upgrade and Full Service Maintenance on VaultSteam EasyViewer. The Contracting Officer determined that the circumstances of the contract action deem only one source reasonable available.

Award will be made on or about 15 Apr 2026

NOTE: INTERESTED VENDORS, PLEASE RESPOND TO THIS NOTICE ON OR

BEFORE 25 March 2026, 4:00 PM CDT.

Medical Readiness Contracting Office – West intends to make a sole source award to:

Olympus America, Inc.

3500 Corporate PKWY

Center Valley, PA 18034

Place of Delivery:

William Beaumont Army Medical Center

Fort Bliss, TX

POC: darryl.o.bryant.civ@health.mil
